date_note: VGC reported on 19 November that the group was claiming to have released the build, a day before DonanimHaber's 20 November article; neither page gives an earlier date for the claimed release.
exec: A group claims to have leaked a 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6; the files are unverified and DonanimHaber says Rockstar has made no official statement.
geo_basis: company headquarters (not stated in the source)
plain: A group called Cyberleek says it shared a 209 GB Xbox version of GTA 6 over BitTorrent. The files have not been independently verified.
summary: A group called Cyberleek claims to have released an Xbox development build of GTA 6 by torrent, with the main executable withheld, VGC and DonanimHaber report; DonanimHaber gives the archive as 209 GB. DonanimHaber says the files have not been verified by independent sources and Rockstar has made no official statement. VGC says Take-Two has filed multiple subpoenas to Discord seeking information on specific servers and users.
title: Cyberleek claims leak of 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6; unverified

evidence.quote: GTA 6'nın Kasım 2026 tarihli olduğu öne sürülen Xbox sürümüne ait 209 GB'lık dosyalar sızdırıldı.

validation.note: Tarnkappe (22 Nov) also reports the claim, says authenticity could not be independently confirmed and that neither Rockstar nor Take-Two had commented. Follow-up 22 Nov: VGC (19 Nov) and DonanimHaber (20 Nov) both report the claim; neither verifies the build (VGC: screenshots on social media 'appear to show' a development build). No Rockstar or Take-Two statement on this build was found; a GamesRadar headline says Xbox is working with Take-Two and Rockstar after the leaks, but its body could not be read. VideoCardz returned HTTP 402.
